review.note: Proclamation of Feb. 22, 1897 (No. 31), 29 Stat. 911, Cleveland; effective March 1, 1898. Lineage note: this Flathead Forest Reserve was merged into Lewis and Clarke in 1903 (33 Stat. 2311); the present Flathead NF was re-created from Lewis and Clark by EO 835, June 25, 1908.
